SELECT l.id,l.entity_id,l.action,l.created_at,l.actor_user_id,l.request_id,
 l.before_json->>'work_type' old_work_type,l.before_json->>'creation_year_start' old_year_start,l.before_json->>'creation_year_end' old_year_end,l.before_json->>'created_at' artwork_created_at,l.before_json->>'current_institution_id' old_institution,l.after_json->>'updated_by' after_editor,
 a.status current_status,a.primary_media_id current_media_id,a.current_institution_id,m.id old_media_still_in_db,m.storage_path old_media_path,m.checksum_sha256 old_checksum,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM artworks refs WHERE refs.primary_media_id=m.id) old_media_reused_as_primary
 FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN artworks a ON a.id=l.entity_id LEFT JOIN media_assets m ON m.id=NULLIF(l.before_json->>'primary_media_id','')::uuid WHERE l.id=ANY(%s::uuid[]) ORDER BY l.created_at,l.id
